title: Docker & Cloud Concepts Introduction
intro: Docker and cloud (fresher level) introduces the deployment concepts a junior backend developer meets. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with what Docker is and the container-vs-VM distinction, then the image-vs-container model and Dockerfiles. Docker commands follow at the applied tier, then the cloud tier — cloud concepts, SaaS/PaaS/IaaS, and microservices as the architecture these tools enable.
